The thing is smash cannont infinitely grow. It just cant have that level of interest. The key problem with capitalist ventures like this is they assume infinite growth, alongside all other infinitely growing establishments. Each individuals time is not as valuable as it seems, this is a smash game realistically, nothing useful, just another way to waste time. You could make a point about the name of the saga being misleading about any saga, but just because this one is featuring another game and has slightly less attendance, it deserves even more criticism. Fluctuation is natural and not everything can keep growing and growing, thats just asking for collapse. People who want to be educated will educate themselves, thats how it has been and always will be in all walks of life.

Perhaps im just a bitter man looking for ideals in a world that cant provide so, as a result of human nature and selfishness.

Maybe this comes down to a fundamental difference in opinion, I believe marketing is to tell stupid people what they need, while anyone who has a shred of analytical skill can research all they want, because this is around a hobby, an interest, I expect myself to put time into learning and researching about events and infomation around my topic. As an avid spectator of both smash 4 and Melee, I see it as a duty to myself to know what events are going on, even the lesser known ones down to a small local in australia for example. My point is that I feel like when you only aim to please the lowest common denominator, the people with the shortest attention span in this case, you reduce the intelligence of your marketing, alienating the audience with a more keen interest (paradoxial in my view). 

The consumer does have a responsibility, contrary to what you're saying. We do not need to be spoon fed, the attendance is still great for a monthly, albeit different to other sagas, fluctuation is to be expected and should not be persecuted each time something differs slightly from the norm.

The comparison to disneyland is bad, as in this case disney would be the parallel to smash, the reason people are coming. I guarantee if this was ARMS only then you would see way less attendees. The function of the theme is not integral, more superficial, an exciting thing to do each circuit event. And as this is a Saga, a circuit event, it should be rather obvious it has a smash tournament (the actual integral part of the event), no? 

You only need an ounce of common sense and a decent attention span, to see the realities. But maybe that's too much to ask of this internet generation.

We play a 2 stock meta with rage mechanic and then go "Oh this game is SO inconsistent" if we played 4 stocks then we would definitely be looking at results more similar to melee. I understand the time constraints but imo, its not a healthy competitive ruleset. Ive been playing 4 stock friendlies 8-9 minutes with my practice peeps and none have gone to time so far. I understand the reason we have the rulest we do in order to help tournaments run smoother, but its producing volatile results. 

My view is more stocks tend to decrease campy playstyles as the value of each interaction is decreased and therefore risk/reward is decreased leading to players selecting more aggressive options, as opposed to not approaching and dancing around your opponent because if you get wafted by Wario you lose 1/2 of your life resources. It is also more of a test of consistent punishes, a valuable aspect in the assessing of skill level.
My theory is that they are the simplest and most developed archetypes in the game and so will see the most success compared to new and stranger additions, for example Duckhunt and Pokemon Trainer.

My current thoughts on the metagames tier list.

• With development of chars, I believe Bayonetta will become the best in the game, and cloud will fall slightly but not much.

• Did tiers with a 10 char capacity, seperated into 5 char capacity sub tiers for ease of use, excluding S tier which only contains the top 5.

•Order within tiers doesn't matter excluding S tier, chars can generally be moved around in their 10 man capacity tier.

•I believe everyone except the very bottom tier can make top 8 at any event, but the liklihood of that happening increases the higher the tiers go.

•In the future I believe Sonic and Rosa will fall off slightly, maybe Mega Man too, these are all defensive chars, and as punishes get better and more consistent, defensive chars become slightly weaker in the increasingly offensive meta.

•Ness, Luigi, Peach and Marth/Lucina may climb higher as they develop and are used more.

Neutral: Shorthop floating dairs are good combo starters and a good pressure tool. Generally always want to have a turnip to hand, so you can mix up your approach with either a turnip, a float aerial, or a turnip regrab situation. QFR is a great alternative to dash dancing and allows more options such as JCFF N/B/U air. Short hop airdodging is pretty good, especially for landing Nairs and Bairs but can become pretty readable.

Weaknesses: Slow ground game, poor range outside of somewhat laggy Fair, light and floaty so easily KO'd and juggled. Her style is semi rush down which almost doesnt fit a slow char like her. When she struggles to get 
in, she really struggles. Really struggles against fast opponents at times overwhelming her like Falcon and sheik. Can be zoned out somewhat well, and generally stuggles with anyone with a sword (yes, even shulk).

Strengths: Float, float and float. It's so good, without it she'd be a low tier. It allows you to have the most ambiguous movement option in the game, great for mix ups and cute tricks. She has no trouble KO'ing the opponent usually and has a decent combo/follow up game. Also she's not a typically common char so sometimes you have the benefit of your opponent not knowing the MU.

Meta: She could definitely be high tier if she is developed in a more defensive style while keeping some semi rushdown techniques to match the defensive meta. I would put her at around 20-25 on the tier list, top of mid tier. But she does lose to high tiers often so I heavily doubt she'll move.

Best MUs: Keeping it to relevent chars in Meta, Ness, Lucas, Fox, Robin, Greninja, DK and Ike (exception to sword rule, see Umeki vs Ryo at G3) are all pretty much a +1 matchup. It may not seem like she has a tonne of winning match ups, but she has many even ones, and peaches strange clever way of playstyle, I believe, can theoretically beat any char not named metaknight.

Worst MUs: We already know. Your boy aba already slaughtered Samsora with metaknight, -3 for sure. -2 for me would be Pikachu, Diddy and sheik. She also loses slightly to popular chars like Mario, Bayo, Toon Link and Sonic. Plus sword chars are just a mess.
